Flutter has quietly become one of the best frameworks to build with an AI agent. Google now ships official Agent Skills that teach it Flutter conventions, a Dart MCP server for the analyzer, tests and hot reload, and MCP tools that let it launch the app, tap through screens and take screenshots.
